title: Oracle Evening Brief
script_summary: Bitcoin holds flat at $62,937 after a quiet US close, with no daily high or low to mark. Fear & Greed sits at 27, signaling caution despite the lack of downside. Network health stands out: hashrate at 1,028.9 EH/s shows miners remain committed, while the mempool stacks 90,886 transactions at a low 3 sat/vB fastest fee. Block 960,655 just cleared. Overnight, watch for any fee spikes or hashrate dips that could signal shifting miner behavior into Asia hours.
